A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Thustra system/Legends|Thustra system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] began their full invasion of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] territory, pressing out from their victory during the [[Taris Siege|First Battle of]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. One of the prongs of their assault sent them through Thustra.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It was marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.
